fit.cover: fills the frame, crops the overflow (the common case)
fit.contain: fits entirely inside the frame, may letterbox
fit.fill: stretches to the frame, ignores the media's own ratio
fit.none: renders the media at its natural size
fit.scale-down: the smaller of contain or the media's natural size

radius.top: rounds only the block-start edge — flush media atop a rounded card body
radius.surface: matches a card/panel corner radius, the default
radius.pill: fully rounded, e.g. a circular avatar-style frame

rules.as: Polymorphic host; the caller owns semantics (figure, div, or a Link/Button wrapping the frame).
